gaps.title: Rapid multi-site rollout with no stated unified monitoring platform
gaps.detail: Snowman is expanding or opening at least five facilities in 2026 alone (Hyderabad, Pune, Kolkata, Krishnapatnam, Patna) under an asset-light Built-to-Suit model. Fast, geographically dispersed rollout like this raises the risk of siloed, per-site temperature monitoring and inconsistent compliance reporting unless every new warehouse is tied into one platform from day one.
gaps.based_on: Beyond Hyderabad, Snowman is expanding in Pune (adding a 5,900-pallet facility by June 2026 on top of an existing 16,000-pallet site) and has projects underway in Kolkata, Krishnapatnam, and Patna; also the July 2026 Hyderabad Built-to-Suit expansion to 16,800 pallets.

gaps.title: Pharma cold-chain compliance load without confirmed automated audit reporting
gaps.detail: Snowman explicitly serves pharmaceutical clients across facilities running -25°C to +20°C. India's Revised Schedule M and WHO-GDP/ALCOA+ rules require continuous deviation monitoring and audit-ready records at that scale; without a named automated compliance layer, per-site manual logging is a real regulatory exposure as pharma volume grows.
gaps.based_on: Snowman serves pharmaceuticals, quick-service restaurants (QSR), seafood, and e-commerce clients; the Hyderabad facility offers temperature-controlled storage from -25°C to +20°C.

gaps.title: 600+ vehicle reefer fleet without a stated real-time asset-tracking layer
gaps.detail: A 600+ truck fleet moving perishable and pharma cargo pan-India is a large, distributed, high-value asset base. In-transit cold-chain breaches are typically harder to catch than in-warehouse ones, and no GPS/telematics or tamper-detection platform is named in available research.
gaps.based_on: Snowman operates a fleet of 600+ trucks, including primary and secondary refrigerated (reefer) vehicles.

pitch.angle: Snowman is scaling fast — five-plus new or expanded pan-India sites in 2026 alone — while its core business is pharma and perishables, where a single missed temperature deviation is a compliance incident, not just a customer complaint. GND's ThinxFresh platform (live BLE/LoRa sensors, instant deviation alerts, auto-generated compliance reports) gives a fast-growing multi-site network the one thing public materials don't show it already has: a single dashboard covering every warehouse and truck as it comes online.
pitch.opener: Congrats on the Hyderabad and Pune expansions — as you bring five-plus new pan-India sites live this year, how are you keeping temperature compliance and deviation alerts consistent across all of them?
